Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the call this morning. We're excited about Redwood's serving guarantees but need a clearer picture of how a retainer-based premium support engagement would look for Acme. A few specific asks from my side and from procurement: 

- What does "critical-path" coverage include in practical terms (on-call, hours, escalation ladder)?
- Target response times for P1/P2/P3, and whether those are business-hours or 24/7; turnaround definitions for root-cause analysis (RCA).
- How do uptime tiers map to credits or refunds? Acme needs a table with 99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99 bands and concrete credits.
- Discounting: we have a committed-spend conversation here — what discounts apply at 50k, 150k, and 300k annual spend levels? Any incentives for annual prepay?

I've attached our draft SOW and the procurement template so legal can see the starting point. Can you send a line-item pricing + retainer structure we can circulate?

Sylvia,

Thanks — appreciate the clear list. Below is a concise proposal we can iterate on. I tried to keep language procurement-friendly (line items + optional add-ons). Happy to hop on a call with legal this week.

Summary (proposal):
- Engagement model: Monthly retainer + incident credits. Retainer guarantees 24/7 on-call escalation for critical-path incidents affecting production inference (model serving, KV cache corruption, runtime OOMs affecting live traffic).

SLA / Response table:
- Critical / P1: Initial acknowledgement within 15 minutes; engineer assigned and triage begins within 1 hour; 24/7 on-call with phone bridge for sev1.
- High / P2: Acknowledgement within 2 hours; working remediation plan within 8 business hours.
- Normal / P3: Acknowledgement within 1 business day; plan within 3 business days.

Uptime tiers & credits:
- 99.99%: no credit.
- 99.95% - 99.989%: 5% monthly service credit.
- 99.9% - 99.949%: 15% monthly service credit.
- <99.9%: 30% monthly service credit and right to terminate after 30 days if not remedied.

Retainer pricing (examples):
- Bronze: $8,000/month — 9x5 email/Slack support, response windows above, no guaranteed on-call phone; included 4 incident credits per year.
- Silver: $25,000/month — 24/7 on-call escalation for P1, prioritized queue, included 12 incident credits/year.
- Gold (critical-path): $60,000/month — 24/7 on-call, named response engineer, quarterly on-site/virtual runbook review, included 30 incident credits/year.

Discounting:
- 10% off retainer pricing at $50k+ committed ARR (12 months).
- 18% off at $150k+ committed ARR with annual prepay.
- 25% off at $300k+ committed ARR with annual prepay and 12-month exclusivity window.

Optional add-ons:
- Rapid-response add-on: guaranteed 30-minute bridge for P1 for an additional $10,000/month.
- Extended RCA package: detailed 10-day RCA + postmortem for $5,000/event beyond included credits.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which retainer band you want as a starting point (Bronze/Silver/Gold).
2) We can provide a redlineable SOW + pricing sheet (I'll include Marissa and Karthik for approval).
3) If acceptable, legal & procurement can route PO/DocuSign and we can schedule a kickoff.

Attachments referenced: ACME_SOW_v2.docx (per your attachment) — we'll provide a redlineable SOW with the pricing grid.

Thanks,

Hannah — quick thoughts from pricing:

- For $150k committed ARR with annual prepay, we can offer 22% off the monthly retainer lines and include Rapid-response add-on at 50% off for the first 6 months. That matches our incumbent displacement playbook.
- For $300k+ we can go to 28% off with a 6-month SLAs review clause (to avoid margin erosion if usage spikes).
- Bronze band is not margin-friendly; recommend pushing Silver as minimum for enterprise customers where they expect on-call.

Also recommend tightening the uptime credits language: credits should be calculated pro rata against the monthly retainer (not usage fees) and capped at 50% of the monthly retainer to avoid extreme refunds. Add a clause excluding scheduled maintenance windows and customer-caused outages.

If Acme agrees to 12-month prepay at $150k, countersigned PO + DocuSign = final.

Karthik
VP, Commercial Pricing — Redwood Inference
